checks: Enter immediately after login opens focused chat; WASD, F, Space and potion keys type only; Escape cancels without sending.
Knight and Druid registration creates distinct class stats in the same shared world.
Level-one movement is about 100 px/s and is visible to the second client.
E beside the merchant opens inventory despite overlapping NPC ranges; equipment changes authoritative armor and purchases without gold are disabled.
Party invitation and acceptance work between desktop and touch clients.
Enter opens chat with a HUD button focused; another client receives the public speech, draws it over the character and retains it in the chat log.
Real touch movement works; desktop, landscape, portrait and mobile inventory render without page overflow.
Explicit PvP target and safety toggle work; a protected beginner in town takes no damage and causes no skull.
Relog preserves account/class and resets PvP safety; localStorage contains no password.
E at the quest NPC opens the journal; accepting a real quest updates the tracker and J reopens its progress.
A fresh knight kills three rats with normal movement/attacks, levels up, cannot claim remotely, and returns to the NPC for the quest reward.
The mill is discovered in the atlas; returning grants a usable class weapon (+5 attack) and unlocks the goblin expedition.
A mage strafes while shooting: the real target and projectile endpoints stay fixed and attack aim differs from walking direction.
Mage fire ring emits a timed area effect, is captured at two animation phases, costs mana, and the potion hotkey consumes an owned potion.
All four registration choices were used against the real server; Paladin uses a bow.
